title: Finger Pathway Atlas V4
scope: Representative connected anatomical model in one millimetre coordinate system. Detailed V3 cellular templates and all supplied anatomical surfaces are retained. Some cortical templates preserve measured human light-microscopy skeletons and radii; noncortical templates are the original procedural V3 models. Template reuse, cell placement, long-range extensions and synaptic assignments are modeled. This is not a full biological cell census, a measured end-to-end human connectome, EM segmentation, or a physiological simulation. Selected conscious sensory and motor routes are represented; other neural networks are outside this model. The cortical display is restricted to the left precentral and postcentral gyri. A separate paired coronal inspection adds six-layer representative samples and actual H01 neurite references; shapes, laminar proportions and new connectivity are modeled.

morphology.basis: Preserved detailed V3 cellular templates, with declared intact-support amendments and modeled V4 placement/connectivity; not an EM segmentation.
morphology.dimensions: Original template dimensions are retained in micrometres and converted to millimetres without rescaling to fit. Original procedural dimensions remain assumptions. Source-figure panels are independently resized and are not matched-scale validation.
morphology.meissner: Original V3 terminal and lamellar support geometry retained. Its regular axon-loop topology remains a known mismatch to the longitudinal/protrusion-rich mouse EM references; preservation is not a new anatomical-validation claim.
morphology.pacinian: Original central neural ending retained. All 25 original support lamellae retain their original count, size and tessellation; the inspection opening is closed. Fine protrusion and individual support-cell anatomy remain limited by the V3 model.
morphology.drg: Original synthetic pseudounipolar soma, fused stem and satellite support retained. The old isolated T-branches are replaced by connected world routes. No dendrites or ganglion synapses are added.
morphology.nmj: Original V3 human-inspired terminal arbor, receptor islands, junctional-fold crests and Schwann support retained. These are procedural models, not traced human NMJs. The old open comparison-muscle surface is excluded.
morphology.proprioception: Original V3 spindle and Golgi tendon-organ components are separated into distinct model afferents. The spindle support opening is closed. The two group-II spindle examples use explicitly modeled secondary terminals rather than relabeling the original Ia-like source. Reference images include sheep extraocular tissue; the templates are not human finger end-organ reconstructions or validated human size measurements.
morphology.noncortical: Original V3 synthetic spinal, cuneate and VPL somata and arbors retained. Cell-class reuse and location are declared; Nissl images do not establish full dendritic connectivity.
morphology.cortical: Ten Allen human bright-field SWC templates retain their source skeletons/radii and original V3 generated surfaces. Sources are middle temporal gyrus, frontal lobe and inferior frontal gyrus, not measured finger S1/M1 neurons. Six source layer-II/III spiny cells with intact apical dendrites provide morphological analogues for the modeled upper-motor cells; they are not identified layer-V corticospinal neurons. H01 EM images are comparison references only and are not the source of these meshes.
morphology.h01: Twelve connected H01 proofread neurite components, two from each source layer, rigidly transplanted as references into modeled M1/S1 tissue. H01 is temporal cortex. Neurite skeletons/radii are source-derived; soma display ellipsoids, placement and continued axons are modeled. See /assets/finger-pathway-atlas/v4/h01/reference-neurites.json and soma-layer-records.json.

limitations: Retained source geometry does not establish measured V4 cell identities, atlas registration, synapse positions or long-range connectivity.
The detailed V3 noncortical templates remain procedural; known shape limitations in the supplied comparison plates are not erased by restoration.
Source microscopy spans different species, tissue regions and scales. H01 comparison images do not make the Allen-derived display meshes EM reconstructions.

Original cellular traces can be incomplete biological specimens. The model retains their available branches and adds explicitly modeled route extensions; it is not a complete experimental reconstruction of every neuron.
Local myelin remains a bounded display representation with modeled nodal spacing and sheath ratio.
No electrical activity or biomechanical response is simulated; autonomic, cerebellar, reticular and other networks are outside the selected routes.
The 50 comparison plates show V3 baseline model panels, not screenshots of the integrated V4 placement.
Paired cortical sections are MRI-style constructions, not MRI segmentation, and occupy separate anterior-posterior planes. Nominal thickness, fractions, packing and connectivity are priors.
All axonal rendering uses solid cylinders; overview radius padding is a display aid. The paired view can disable padding for physical diameter.
No DKI data is fitted. DKI references inform future bundle-orientation modeling, not measured individual axons, diameters or synapses.

anatomicalSurfaces.method: All supplied V3 rest-pose position bytes and triangle indices are retained in deferred detail assets. Overview display meshes are spatially clustered. No anatomical source surface is dropped.
anatomicalSurfaces.scope: Exact preservation of the supplied V3 atlas surfaces, not a claim of original unprocessed BodyParts3D STL resolution.

cellularTemplates.method: Original V3 neural morphology preserved without simplification. Local-origin translation and exclusion of whole context meshes/connected components occur. Pacinian and spindle support inspection openings are closed at their original shell count, radii and resolution. Source branches are retained as exact centerlines for low-detail rendering.
cellularTemplates.registration: Original local micrometre geometry is rigidly rotated and translated, with an exact factor of 0.001 millimetres per micrometre. Source template identities and V4 modeled cell identities remain separate.
cellularTemplates.delivery: Only compressed template assets are deployed. The jsonBytes field reports their uncompressed serialized size, not additional deployed copies. Templates load individually on demand; the full collection is not required at startup.

retained: Original V3 neural membrane vertices, normals and triangle connectivity for the exported cellular components.
Original DRG implicit somata and fused proximal stems, conformal satellite-cell patches, and noncortical dendritic arbors.
All ten supplied Allen human cortical tracing templates and their original V3 generated surfaces.
Original sensory terminal, neuromuscular junction and separated spindle/tendon-organ components.
Original captured branch centerlines for lighter display; separate original modeled spine/bouton detail remains labeled synthetic.

amended.description: Pacinian 25-lamella support: inspection opening closed; shell count/radii/resolution retained.
Spindle capsule: inspection opening closed; shell count/radii/resolution retained.

excludedContext: V3 nerve cross-section faces, cut fascicle rims, epineurial inspection windows and spinal section context.
Open skin comparison blocks, NMJ sarcolemma comparison patch and striation guides.
Old long specimen-only DRG T-branches and separate projection fragments, replaced by declared continuous V4 route connections.
preservation.connectionRule: Long-range paths attach at declared original membrane ports. Cortical extensions attach to a retained distal axon leaf. The selected leaf and synaptic partner are modeling choices; neither is measured end-to-end connectivity.

registration.drgPacking: Synthetic packing with complete preserved DRG template bounding radii plus 10% separation; source surface dimensions unchanged.
registration.notice: Original V3 local cell geometry is retained at 1 micrometre = 0.001 millimetre. Anatomical placement, orientation, template reuse and connections between preserved source ports and long-range routes are modeled. Cortical source reconstructions are not measured S1/M1 finger-pathway cells; noncortical V3 geometries remain their original synthetic models.
registration.terminalAnchoring: For each original terminal template, its declared organ center maps to anatomical cell.terminal. The retained incoming stub lies upstream, where its original inlet joins the long-range route. Rigid registration leaves original geometry and physical dimensions unchanged. Organ centers describe the source model, not histologically registered human end organs.

additionalModeledDetail: V3 has no separately reconstructed SA-II receptor geometry; these cells retain an unencapsulated modeled ending.
The two group-II spindle examples use explicitly modeled secondary flower-spray terminals because the retained V3 spindle template is Ia-like; their original DRG morphology is retained.
